thesis: A net-cash Chinese brewer with rising operating and FCF margins trades below its own 5-year minimum cash multiples, pricing shrinkage that its improving operations do not show.
reason: Same evidence as the 2026-11-16 HOLD 4: cash multiples below their 5-year minimums, net cash and improving operating and FCF margins, against slipping ROIC, an unexplained net-income fall and a weak trend. The position is near its target size and cash is near the floor, so no ADD.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 12.0% (14.9% now), reversing the mix and pricing gains.
TTM FCF margin falls below 10.0% (15.3% now), showing the cash step-up was transitory.
TTM ROIC falls below 9.0% (10.8% now), below the FY2024 low of 10.3%.
Net debt/EBITDA (debt minus cash and short-term investments) turns positive from -1.55x TTM, i.e. net cash is gone.
